pairs.question: Quis dedit vobis potestatem ut domum hanc aedificaretis et muros instauraretis?
pairs.answer: Nos sumus servi Dei caeli et terrae et aedificamus templum quod erat extructum ante hos annos multos quodque rex Israhel magnus aedificaverat et extruxerat.
pairs.derivation: The officials' letter to Darius reports their interrogation of the elders. Question taken from v9, dropping the framing 'interrogavimus ergo senes illos et ita diximus eis'. Verse 10 (a separate request for names, 'sed et nomina eorum quaesivimus...') intervenes and is not part of either utterance, so it is skipped. Answer taken from v11, dropping the framing 'huiuscemodi autem sermonem responderunt nobis dicentes' and stopping at the full stop after 'extruxerat'; what follows (v12, 'postquam autem ad iracundiam provocaverunt patres nostri...') turns to recounting the exile and is no longer answering the authority question. The answer directly justifies their warrant to build: they are servants of the God of heaven and earth, and the temple was originally built long ago by a great king of Israel.
